[i][sub]Harklight Fortress, Mineros[/sub][/i]

[i]Gaius Cornelius Rufinus was announced and ushered in before me. He had a scar across his face, having been deployed and injured during the catastrophic civil war, where death was constant. The battle-hardened soldier knelt before me, eyes closed.

"Legatus Rufinus, I am sending you to Vespuria. Take your 4th Legion with you as your personal guard." I commanded him. "Try not to be hostile, I want the locals to know we are not a threat to them, but if you are attacked, do what is necessary and show no mercy. Here are your orders."

 I handed him a telegram, instructions to establish an embassy and start trading with the people of High Albany. "This is for their leader's eyes only. No one else's. If their leader is absent, hand it to their second in command and initiate. This may be vital to our future, and I do not want this to fall into the wrong hands. You must succeed, am I understood?"

"Yes, my Rex!" He looked up, his eyes triumphant. He took the telegram, bowed to me and then shook hands with my Adjutant. He left, gathered his Legion, and marched South towards Caprium, where Gaius would embark and travel to High Albany by sea, using our Navy as transport.

Back In Mineros, I summoned Legatus Marcus Junius Silvanus of the 9th Legion. He was also ushered before me. I gave him the same instructions as I did to Gaius, handing him a telegram with the same instructions, but to bring his 9th Legion as his personal guard, and to begin negotiations with [nation=noflag]Bantarus[/nation], known as Jomsland. I sent him off and he traveled by sea, as well. I also sent messengers before Marcus and Gaius to said nations, declaring that they would be contacted by us soon.

After this, I returned to Caprium with my royal entourage. I held a large feast and an goat sacrifice dedicated to the Gods, hoping they would favor us, and I could only pray and hope my men succeeded.[/i][/quote]
[b][i]Official Response from the Second Commonwealth of Jomsland[/i][/b]

To Legatus Marcus Junius Silvanus of the 9th Legion,  

Your arrival in Jomsland has been noted, and you are welcomed as an envoy of your people. Ours is a land of strong traditions, where strength and hospitality walk hand in hand. We recognize the journey you have undertaken across the sea and extend the courtesy befitting a guest who comes in peace.  
If your purpose is to engage in diplomacy, know that Jomsland values open and forthright discourse. Our High King and the Althing shall receive you in due course, where we may discuss matters of mutual interest. While your 9th Legion accompanies you as your guard, we trust that your intentions are in good faith, and in that same spirit, we shall ensure your safe passage and comfort while you are in our lands.  
May your stay in Jomsland be met with firm handshakes, shared mead, and words of wisdom exchanged by the hearth. We look forward to hearing what you bring before us.  

By the will of Wadruna and the people of Jomsland,  

[i]Jarl Freyderic of Marskborg, Minister for Foreign Affairs of the Second Commonwealth of Jomsland[/i]

Your words are received in good faith, and we acknowledge your intent to foster trade and opportunity between our nations. Jomsland has long thrived on the strength of commerce and the bonds of honorable dealings, and we welcome the chance to hear what you propose.
You are granted permission to dock at the Grand Port of Heiðabýr, our capital, where you and your delegation shall be received with the courtesy due to honored guests. Our representatives shall meet you upon arrival to escort you to the High Kings hall, where discussions may begin in earnest.

May the seas grant you swift passage, and may your arrival mark the beginning of good relations between our nations.

Heiðabýr, Jomsland  Arrival of the 9th Legion's Convoy

The gray northern sky hung low over the bustling port of Heiðabýr, Jomslands largest and most historic harbor. The scent of salt and diesel filled the air as container ships, fishing trawlers, and sleek naval vessels shared the waters. The deep hum of industry resonated from the dockyards, where cranes lifted cargo, and workers in heavy coats moved with well-practiced efficiency.  
As the convoy of Legatus Marcus Junius Silvanus approached, the Jomslandic Coast Guard vessels shadowed their approach, a standard security measure for foreign military arrivals. Their presence was not hostile, merely a reminder that Jomsland maintained control over its waters. Once clearance was confirmed, the escort peeled away, allowing the foreign ships to glide into the designated docking area.  
Waiting on the pier was a delegation of Jomslandic officials and military officers. At the forefront stood Minister of Foreign Affairs Jarl Freyderic of Marskborg, dressed in a dark overcoat, his gloved hands resting behind his back as he observed the arrival. Beside him, General Sören Hjalmarsson, representing the Ministry of Defense, wore a black and gold Jomslandic Armed Forces uniform, his expression unreadable behind his aviator sunglasses.  
As the first members of the 9th Legion stepped onto Jomslandic soil, Jarl Freyderic stepped forward, offering a firm handshake to Legatus Silvanus.  
"Welcome to Jomsland, Legatus. We acknowledge your journey across the sea and trust it was without trouble. The High King and the other Jarls looks forward to hearing what you have to offer. You and your delegation will be escorted to the capital, where formal discussions will take place. In the meantime, we extend our hospitalityshould you or your men require rest or provisions, our facilities are at your disposal."  
Behind him, dark blue SUVs with the royal emblem and military vehicles idled, waiting to transport the foreign delegation towards Bondahall, the High Kings Residence.

[quote=versia;58967997][spoiler=March of the 14th Legion - Grand Speech][i][b]March of the 14th Legion[/b][/i]

[i]First stanza
"Sumus Quartadecumani Legio Gemina! (repeat x1)
Aufer te, de via decedite! (repeat x1)

Second stanza
Cornu sonat pedem inferre! (repeat x1)
Milites Versiani, procedite!" (repeat x1)
[/i]

[i]The singing followed me as I entered the great city of Mineros. My 14th Legion marched behind me, their boots stamping on the roads in unison. We stopped before the gates of the city, which were opened.

Many officers and soldiers, as well as a majority of Versia's miners, were stationed here, and they saluted me as I passed. My holding, Harklight Fortress, stood before me. My men dispersed and formed a line leading to the front door, rifles gripped firmly in their hands. Rain began pouring down, followed by flashes of lightning and the sounds of thunder. The doors were opened as the song "Invocatio ad Dianam", an old Versian religious song of the Ordo Custodum, was sung loudly yet beautifully by my servants on the upper levels of my throne room.

I entered said throne room, and everyone stopped what they were doing to kneel before me. The rain poured down harder, and I could hear the wind howl over the heavenly music. The singing continued as a large device, peddled in front of me by my Adjutant, continously flashed red, then green. I was confused. I've never seen a device such as this, but then Asseylum gave me a thumbs up, signaling I was ready to start. My expression turned tense. I've not made a speech like this since... the end of the Civil War? I raised my hand in salute to the Versian banner, which hung over the entrance to the Fortress. "Versia, Aeterna!" I cried. 

"Aeterna, aeterna!" They saluted to the flag as well. It felt like addressing soldiers before a battle.

"My loyal subjects! Today, two things have reached me. First, the nation of [nation]Akhratia[/nation] has unexpectedly expanded, securing their southern border and creating border friction between our people! That was and still is our land by divine right! Ours to exploit, ours to rule! So, in response to this heinous act, I will send 500,000 heavily armed colonists and my 14th Stormtrooper Legion, to conquer the treacherous mountains to the northwest! We will form a Colonia so large, our enemies will bow down before us!" I clenched my fist, which signalled my messenger, who nodded and left the Fortress. He gathered the men and I could hear my Legion singing as they marched north. Applause erupted once again and I raised my hand to silence it. 

"Second! My cousin Julius Valerian Cassiodorus Vers Allusia, who visited [nation]The Crystalline Empire[/nation] on a goodwill mission, discovered the unbelievable and disgusting terrorist hijacking that followed! He almost lost his life, but returned safe and sound thanks to the help of our friends in Thyven, and is recovering. [nation]Sal-Baliz[/nation] must be held accountable for their actions, they must face justice to the fullext extent! I declare, as Rex, that them, and any nation who supports the rats of that backwater hellhole called [nation]Sal-Baliz[/nation], will be declared enemies of the state and hunted down! I will not rest until I am dead or Versia's enemies lie in ruins!" The masses went wild, from cheering to calling my name. I tried to calm them, but they continued chanting. 

"Bellum, bellum, bellum!" They cried. I looked to Asseylum, who cut the broadcast.[/i][/spoiler]

[spoiler=March of the 14th Legion - Coloniae Ferrumontis]
[i]Legatus Lucius Cornelius Geminus pov[/i]

[i]When the King's messenger approached me, he gave me a message: to march northeast and create settlements in the flat areas of the mountains. This was no easy task. Trucks full of supplies, weapons, and ammo, followed by hordes of civilian colonists, followed by myself and my Legion, traveled North, up the mountain path, and settled in the higher elevations of Mount Olympus, close to the legendary ruins of the old Temple of Jupiter. The civilians instantly began constuction efforts, building a large fortress using the supplies we brought with us. We used the spring water provided by the Mountains of the Gods to sustain ourselves, as food would be provided to us in intervals via transport. It took a full week to build, everyone chipping in to build it as fast as they could. It was named Fortress Olympus, and when it was complete, I sent word to Caprium via radio that it was finished. They responded by sending us artillery pieces, sandbags, uniforms, armor, mining equipment, and more ammunition than we could count, included with instructions to fortify and prepare our position, now called Coloniae Ferrumontis. I acknowledged and turned off the radio before returning to my new post.[/i]
[/spoiler]
